title: Coefficients of a measure representation are integrable on compact subsets (testing with χ·dx^β)
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ and U, W ⊆ ℝ^P with W open and W ⊆ U. Let T ∈ GeometricCurrentOn U n, μ a measure on ℝ^P and v : ℝ^P → NVector (Eucl P) n with IsMeasureRepresentation T μ v: for every ω ∈ TestFormOn U n, x ↦ v(x)(ω(x)) is μ-integrable and T(ω) = ∫ v(x)(ω(x)) dμ(x). Let K ⊆ ℝ^P be compact with K ⊆ W, and let β ∈ SimonMultiIndex n P. Then the coefficient function x ↦ euclideanNVectorCoordinate (v x) β = v(x)(dx^β) is μ-integrable on K (IntegrableOn … K μ). Here dx^β := wedgeCovectors n (fun j ↦ EuclideanSpace.proj (β j)).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U W : Set (Eucl P)), IsOpen W → W ⊆ U → ∀ (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (μ : Measure (Eucl P)) (v : Eucl P → NVector (Eucl P) n), IsMeasureRepresentation T μ v → ∀ K : Set (Eucl P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ W → ∀ β : SimonMultiIndex n P, IntegrableOn (fun x => euclideanNVectorCoordinate (v x) β) K μ
